CheckTitle: Inline Policies allow full admin access
Description: IAM roles or users have been observed with inline policies attached that allow full "*" administrative privileges.
Risk: Granting full admin privileges does comply with the principle of least privilege, and a compromised identity may result in data exfiltration or deletion, configuration changes or lateral movement. User attached policies in general are also not considered a good practice, due to the increased management complexity.

Recommendation.Text: Remove any IAM policies that full admin access, and avoid attaching policies directly on users. Instead, users should inherit permissions from groups or roles.
